chunks.text:
Admin > SSO > Setup:
To enable SAML single sign-on, open Admin then Security then Single sign-on. Upload your identity provider metadata XML and set the audience URI to your tenant URL.
chunks.body: To enable SAML single sign-on, open Admin then Security then Single sign-on. Upload your identity provider metadata XML and set the audience URI to your tenant URL.
chunks.title: Setup

chunks.text:
Admin > SSO > Setup:
After uploading metadata, assign at least one test user to the application before enforcing SSO for everyone, or you can lock yourself out of the tenant.
chunks.body: After uploading metadata, assign at least one test user to the application before enforcing SSO for everyone, or you can lock yourself out of the tenant.
chunks.title: Setup

chunks.text:
Admin > SSO > Sandbox tenants:
Sandbox tenants use a separate audience URI ending in -sandbox. Configure SSO for a sandbox tenant exactly as production, but point the identity provider at the sandbox login URL.
chunks.body: Sandbox tenants use a separate audience URI ending in -sandbox. Configure SSO for a sandbox tenant exactly as production, but point the identity provider at the sandbox login URL.
chunks.title: Sandbox tenants

chunks.text:
Admin > SSO > Troubleshooting:
Error AUTH-403 means the audience URI in the assertion does not match the tenant. Check for a trailing slash, and confirm you are not using the production URI on a sandbox tenant.
chunks.body: Error AUTH-403 means the audience URI in the assertion does not match the tenant. Check for a trailing slash, and confirm you are not using the production URI on a sandbox tenant.
chunks.title: Troubleshooting

chunks.text:
Data > Bulk import > Running an import:
Upload a CSV under Data then Import. The first row must be a header. Imports run asynchronously and you receive an email when the job finishes.
chunks.body: Upload a CSV under Data then Import. The first row must be a header. Imports run asynchronously and you receive an email when the job finishes.
chunks.headingPath: Data > Bulk import > Running an import
chunks.title: Running an import

chunks.text:
Data > Bulk import > Troubleshooting:
An import can finish with status Completed while silently skipping rows. Rows are skipped without an error when a required column is absent from the header, so the importer cannot map them. Open the job report to see the skipped-row count.
chunks.body: An import can finish with status Completed while silently skipping rows. Rows are skipped without an error when a required column is absent from the header, so the importer cannot map them. Open the job report to see the skipped-row count.
chunks.title: Troubleshooting

chunks.text:
Data > Bulk import > Troubleshooting:
Validation failures are different from skipped rows: a validation failure rejects the whole file and reports the offending line number.
chunks.body: Validation failures are different from skipped rows: a validation failure rejects the whole file and reports the offending line number.
chunks.title: Troubleshooting

chunks.text:
Developers > Webhooks > Delivery:
Webhooks are retried with exponential backoff on any non-2xx response. There are five retry attempts over roughly 30 minutes, after which the delivery is marked failed.
chunks.body: Webhooks are retried with exponential backoff on any non-2xx response. There are five retry attempts over roughly 30 minutes, after which the delivery is marked failed.
chunks.title: Delivery

chunks.text:
Developers > Webhooks > Delivery:
Set the X-Signature header check on your endpoint to verify payload authenticity before processing a webhook.
chunks.body: Set the X-Signature header check on your endpoint to verify payload authenticity before processing a webhook.
chunks.title: Delivery

chunks.text:
Developers > API keys > Rotation:
Choose Generate successor to issue a new API key while the original stays valid. The overlap window defaults to 30 days and is capped at 90. Revoke the predecessor once traffic has moved.
chunks.body: Choose Generate successor to issue a new API key while the original stays valid. The overlap window defaults to 30 days and is capped at 90. Revoke the predecessor once traffic has moved.
chunks.title: Rotation

chunks.text:
Billing > Seats > Adding users:
Adding a user consumes a seat immediately and prorates the charge to your next invoice. Deactivating a user releases the seat at the end of the billing period.
chunks.body: Adding a user consumes a seat immediately and prorates the charge to your next invoice. Deactivating a user releases the seat at the end of the billing period.
chunks.title: Adding users

chunks.text:
Billing > Invoices > Downloading:
Invoices are available under Billing then Invoices for 24 months. Download them individually as PDF, or export a CSV summary for a date range.
chunks.body: Invoices are available under Billing then Invoices for 24 months. Download them individually as PDF, or export a CSV summary for a date range.
